text:
Alex Kim: quick heads-up — holding tonight's lift for runtime v3.2.1 in the mutation window. Deploybot flagged an SDK signature mismatch on the integration tests; want ops and SDK leads to eyeball before we clear.

deploybot: automated: release_hold SET on runtime:v3.2.1 reason=SDK-signature-drift tests_failed=3/48 canary_region=eu-west

Jamie Ortiz: on it. which SDK flavor is drifting (python/ts)? any minimal repro to share? @Priya can you spin up infra repro? :mag:

Priya Patel: repro steps below — failing on embedding RPC when header order changes. I reproduced with python sdk 2.8.0 locally.

```
# run the canary suite locally
python infra/tests/run_canary.py --target runtime:v3.2.1 --region eu-west --suite embedding-signing
```

Priya Patel: logs attached in the PR. TL;DR: serializer change in SDK 2.8.0 enforces header canonicalization; runtime expects previous ordering.

Sara Nguyen: FYI release notes draft mentions "serializer tightening" in SDK 2.8.x for signing correctness. If we pin runtime to the older behavior we lose that correctness/perf fix. Need to weigh cost.

Alex Kim: proposal: keep runtime v3.2.1 but gate it with SDK-tagged routing (only SDK >= 2.8.1 routed to v3.2.1). Soft rollout to limit blast radius. Fallback lane = runtime v3.1.9.

Jamie Ortiz: +1 for SDK-version routing. Can deploybot create tag-based routing rules via ops-bot?

ops-bot: deploybot command accepted: create-route-rule runtime:v3.2.1 condition=sdk_version>=2.8.1 rollout=5% region=eu-west

Priya Patel: will run signed-request fuzz against that 5% canary and report results within the change window.

deploybot: helper snippet:
```
curl -s -H "X-SDK-Version: 2.8.1" https://api.redwood.run/runtime/v3.2.1/health | jq '.status, .sig_check'
```

Sara Nguyen: adding release note compatibility blurb: "Runtime v3.2.1 requires SDK >= 2.8.1 for embedding signing; older SDKs will be routed to v3.1.9." Pushing now.

Alex Kim: rollback criteria: abort if canary error rate > 2% OR p99 latency increases > 150ms sustained for 10m. If triggered, route all traffic back to v3.1.9 and open incident channel. Runbook updated.

Jamie Ortiz: please ping support and docs about the softrollout and routing rule (cc @support-leads).

Priya Patel: canary results so far: 45/48 checks passed after a serializer tweak, two flaky signature cases remain. Holding until SDK 2.8.1 patch build lands on pypi/npm. ETA ~40-60m.

Alex Kim: ack. keeping the hold until package is published and eu-west smoke passes. Post final status here when lifted. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
